hints.title: Enumerate Valid Single Rows
hints.text: Use backtracking to find all combinations of bricks summing to width, representing internal seam positions as bitmasks.

hints.title: Define Seam Compatibility
hints.text: Two row configurations can be stacked if they share no common interior seams (mask1 & mask2 == 0).

hints.title: Transition Over Wall Height
hints.text: Iterate height minus one times, transferring the number of valid paths between compatible configurations modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(R^2 * height) where R is count of valid rows (R <= 100)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive building row-by-row without seam compression yields combinatorial explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputing valid seam masks limits the graph to at most ~100 vertices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precompute row seam masks and propagate state transitions vertically.

solutions.approach: Python seam bitmask DFS and adjacency transition DP.
C++ seam bitmask adjacency list and DP vector transitions.
Java adjacency array of lists and DP array iteration.
JavaScript DFS seam collection and iterative modulo DP.
